build.note: every artifact compiled natively on its own architecture - no emulation: arm64 on aarch64, amd64 on x86_64. The amd64 .deb is file-packed on the arm64 host (dpkg-deb is architecture-neutral file packing); its payload is the natively compiled amd64 tree, and it is installed and validated on native amd64.

coexistence.note: packaged under its own package name so it installs side by side with the PostgreSQL 17.2 line (package 'montudb', prefix /opt/montudb/6.0). Distinct prefix, systemd unit, sbin helpers, data dir and doc dir; the 'montudb' system user is deliberately shared and created idempotently by both.
coexistence.verified: both runtime .deb packages installed together in one clean container - no file conflict, both banners resolve

montu_optimizer.line: V6 MBBM (Multi-pass Bloom Bucket Merge) on top of V5 BloomHash, V4 Compose, Condense, OLAP/MRRV and RealCost
montu_optimizer.note: default-OFF; zero catalog change vs the 5.0 line
